name: Gqom x Trance Stomp Bass
desc: FUSES gqom's broken drone-stab low end (bass.gqom.drone_stab) with trance's rolling offbeat 16ths (bass.trance.rolling): C-minor stabs land on the gqom grid, then roll into euphoric 16th runs at the phrase turn.

code.full: note("<[c2 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ c2 ~] [c2 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ ~ eb2] [c2 ~ c2 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~] [~ c2 c2 c2 g1 ~ bb1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').attack(.004).decay(.35).sustain(.3).release(.08).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).lpq(4).shape(.45).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)).every(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[c2 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ c2 ~] [~ c2 c2 c2 ~ c2 eb2 g1]>").add(note(${root})).superimpose(x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.5)).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').attack(.003).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.06).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8,${cut}*1.8).slow(8)).lpq(4).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.72,${gain}).fast(4)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(3).play()
